ai_summary: ABB India delivered an exceptional Q3 CY2026, marked by a 56% surge in orders to INR4,700 crores and a record INR13,000 crore backlog, providing strong revenue visibility through broad-based growth, particularly in Electrification. Despite solid revenue (+19%), EBITDA (+15%), and PAT (+10%) growth, the company navigates headwinds from inflation, commodity prices, and geopolitical factors, impacting margins and necessitating continuous pricing adjustments with a lag effect. A planned leadership transition with a new MD and CFO from January 2027 is underway, while the Automation segment faces cyclical project deferments, though no major red flags were identified beyond these common industry pressures.
